bio: Developer and desk-setup tinkerer. Clean cables, quiet keyboards, small tools that earn their place.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her early 30s with long black hair and round glasses, soft monitor glow on her face, wearing a dark knit sweater, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a tidy dark desk with a mechanical keyboard, a monitor glowing violet and a small plant, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Hands-on builds
collections.description: Small projects on the workbench and the desk.

collections.title: Ambient desks
videos: Desk at night, rain on the window

videos.title: Building a silent keyboard
videos.description: Switches, lube and a quiet afternoon: assembling a compact keyboard from bare parts.
videos.still: Vertical top-down photograph of hands placing a mechanical keyboard switch onto a green circuit board next to a tray of keycaps, tidy desk, soft light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hand presses the switch down into the board and reaches for the next, slow top-down camera drift, soft glints.

videos.title: Desk at night, rain on the window
videos.description: Monitor glow, a mug and rain streaking down the window behind a clean desk.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a clean desk at night with a glowing monitor showing abstract colourful code shapes, a mug, rain on the window behind, no people, no readable text
videos.motion: Rain streaks slowly down the window, steam rises from the mug, monitor light flickers softly, slow push-in.

videos.title: Cable management, finally
videos.description: Velcro, clips and a ruthless afternoon: from spaghetti to a clean back of the desk.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of the underside of a standing desk with neatly bundled black cables in a cable tray and velcro straps, a hand tightening a strap, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hand tightens a strap and smooths the cable bundle, slow camera drift along the tray.

videos.title: Soldering a tiny macropad
videos.description: A hot iron, a bead of solder and a tiny board coming to life.
videos.still: Wide macro photograph of a soldering iron tip touching a small green circuit board with a bead of solder and a wisp of smoke, shallow depth of field, workbench background, no face, no text
videos.motion: A wisp of smoke curls up from the iron tip, the solder melts into a bright bead, slow macro push-in.
